caseStudy.noPublicLink: This project has no public link. I am happy to walk through it in an interview.

bullets: Designed, built and launched two products solo: a multilingual marketplace (slmarket.lk) and SLMarket Flow, a real-time POS/ERP.
Automated releases with GitHub Actions CI/CD, applied TDD with unit and integration tests, and added role-based authorisation and Redis caching.
Implemented Stripe billing (subscriptions, one-time payments, automated proration, webhooks and refunds), processing 200+ transactions across 10+ products.
Built and deployed Node.js, Express.js and MongoDB services for Next.js and TypeScript frontends, with Jest unit and integration tests covering payment and API logic.
Launched AI chatbot solutions for a leading oven company by integrating DIFY.ai workflows with custom Next.js interfaces.
Automated customer interactions with a WhatsApp AI chatbot built with Python, LLM APIs and Twilio.
Delivered client web applications end-to-end, from requirements to deployment, using React, Node.js, Express.js and Spring Boot.
Built a sales counting and analysis tool that replaced a client's manual process.
Built full-stack features with the MERN stack for enterprise applications.
Implemented REST APIs and database operations across the SDLC, from requirements to testing.

solitrium.detail: Teaching full-stack development, OOP, system design, SDLC and Git. Guided 20+ BIT final-year projects through code review.

earth.detail: Taught Web Development, UX Design, Programming, OOP, system design, SDLC and Mathematics, and led Java and web lab sessions.

about.title: From idea to live system
about.paragraph1: I like owning a product from the first sketch to the system people use every day: shaping the data model, designing the API, building the interface, wiring payments and shipping it behind CI/CD.
about.paragraph2: At Softsora I built SaaS platforms, Stripe billing and LLM-powered features. On my own I designed, built and launched SLMarket and SLMarket Flow. I also teach: I founded {academy} and have guided 20+ final-year projects through code review.
about.paragraph3: I use Claude Code, GitHub Copilot and Cursor for speed, and I own the architecture and review every change myself.
